description: This file defines an ApiClient class that manages HTTP communication with the backend server, handling authorization headers, JSON encoding/decoding, and error handling. It provides methods for GET, POST, and DELETE requests, utilizing singleton pattern and environment variables for configuration.

classes.name: ApiClient
classes.description: Singleton class providing methods to perform HTTP requests with authorization and JSON handling.

classes.name: HttpException
classes.description: Custom exception class representing HTTP request failures, including status code and message.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ApiClient.

methods.name: _baseUrl
methods.description: Retrieves the backend base URL from environment variables or defaults to localhost.

methods.name: _headers
methods.description: Generates HTTP headers, including Authorization token if available.

methods.name: _uri
methods.description: Constructs a URI with optional query parameters based on the provided path and query map.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request to the specified path with optional query parameters.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request to the specified path with an optional JSON body.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Performs an HTTP DELETE request to the specified path.

methods.name: _ensureSuccess
methods.description: Checks the HTTP response status and throws an exception if the request failed.

methods.name: _decode
methods.description: Decodes the JSON response body or returns null if empty.
